patch_description: The recommendation asks to sweep the stagger offset dx per adjacent row pair, but two prior variants also showed that corner-anchoring the seed (pulling 4 corner circles into corners) gave a large jump (2.33 → 2.40). I combine both: (a) restore corner anchoring with a small sweep of the anchor distance, and (b) sweep the stagger offsets dx ∈ {0.08, 0.09, 0.10, 0.11, 0.12} applied to staggered (5-circle) rows relative to each neighbor, running a short hill-climb + shift sweep for each candidate seed, keeping the best. This is guaranteed-not-worse: each candidate is refined independently and the best sum wins. To stay within the eval time budget, I use a cheap triage (short LP-solve + quick growth pass) for all candidates and keep the full refinement only for the best one, with reduced iteration counts.
